name: Credential Compromise
summary: Confirmed or strongly suspected compromise of user / service-principal credentials. Covers phishing, infostealer dumps, breach corpus matches, and stolen API tokens.

steps.title: Verify breach-corpus + infostealer feeds are healthy
steps.description: Confirm the credential-leak feed (HIBP / SpyCloud / equivalent) is current and the matching job ran within the last 24h.

steps.title: Confirm MFA enforcement baseline + exception list
steps.description: Review the active MFA enforcement policy and document any exceptions. Make sure break-glass accounts are FIDO2-only.

steps.title: Confirm credential compromise
steps.description: Correlate the alert with sign-in logs: impossible travel, new device, anomalous user agent, MFA-bypass attempts. Confirm vs benign explanation.

steps.title: Enumerate blast radius
steps.description: List every system the account had access to (SSO entitlements, group memberships, OAuth grants, cloud roles). Tag the highest-impact assets.

steps.title: Force sign-out + password reset
steps.description: Revoke all active sessions and refresh tokens; force a password reset with FIDO2 step-up; require re-enrolment of MFA factors.

steps.title: Revoke API tokens + OAuth grants
steps.description: Revoke personal access tokens, app passwords, and OAuth grants attached to the account. Rotate any service-account secret the user could read.

steps.title: Audit for attacker persistence
steps.description: Look for new mail-forwarding rules, OAuth grants the user did not authorise, scheduled tasks on workstations, and SSH key additions.

steps.title: Restore account access for the user
steps.description: After persistence checks pass and the user verifies identity through an out-of-band channel, restore access with hardened MFA settings.

steps.title: Run targeted user training
steps.description: Enroll the affected user in a short refresher on phishing / token handling. Track completion.

steps.title: Strengthen identity controls
steps.description: Close gaps surfaced during the incident: tighten conditional-access, expand FIDO2 coverage, add risk-based-auth signals.
